body: Forward test of the sector cycle/lead indicator method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.72 (naive base rate 0.80) that: AU Small Finance Bank FY27 credit cost (excl. CGFMU premium) is ≤0.90%. Evidence: Q2 FY27 call (24-Oct-2026): H1 credit cost ~73–74 bps (81 bps incl. CGFMU premium) vs guidance 'close to 90 bps'. Loans +25% YoY, deposits +29%. MD Sanjay Agarwal: drought/high oil 'vulnerabilities', 'let's see how quarter three behaves because whatever will be there will come in quarter three'. MPC hiked repo 25 bps to 5.5% with stance 'calibrated tightening'. 99% of MFI book under CGFMU. Reasoning: 16 bps of cushion is decent, but the cycle indicators (rate hikes, El Niño drought in Central India, high fuel) all point to rising small-borrower stress in H2; management itself flags Q3. Shade below base. Resolution: YES if AU's FY27 credit cost on the same basis as the guidance (management states ~90 bps excl. CGFMU premium; H1 was 73–74 bps) is ≤0.90%, as stated in the Q4 FY27 presentation or call. If only the incl.-CGFMU figure is given, YES requires it ≤0.97% (guide + H1 premium gap ~7 bps). Source: AU SFB Q4 FY27 investor presentation / earnings call transcript. Resolve by 2027-05-15; score with Brier vs base rate.

body: Forward test of the decision-card method (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). Probability 0.26 (base rate 0.113, class india_nonfin_1000_20000cr_5y) that: YES if the total-return multiple from 2026-11-23 (entry INR 355.85) to the last close on or before 2031-11-23 is ≤ 0.5, or the stock is delisted/suspended below that level. Model: worksheet scenarios bear 20%→0.59x, base 45%→1.70x, bull 15%→2.74x with σ=0.30; reverse DCF base-case IRR 10.9%; card rule output: size 0: blocked by Expected value vs hurdle (EV 1.39x anchored (raw 1.35x) vs hurdle 1.76x → below hurdle → size 0). Score with Brier vs the base rate.

data.base_rate_reasoning: India non-financial, mcap Rs 1,000-20,000 cr at T, 5 yrs from 30-Sep-2016 and 30-Sep-2018 (survivorship-free, dead firms included, stratum-weighted). n=208 company-snapshots (54 distress-census D, 153 live L at weight 5.63, 1 delisted-other X at 4.26); 95% CIs (company bootstrap within stratum): P(>=3x) 14.1-28.7%, P(<=0.5x) 7.0-16.1%, P(blow-up) 10.2-21.4%. Two start dates only, and they disagree (2016: >=3x 16%, blow-up 21%; 2018: 26%, 10%). Price return only (no dividends, ~1%/yr). Blow-up = close <=0.2x the close at T, liquidation or compulsory delisting (no fraud field). Remaining survivorship leak toward FEWER failures (IBBI firms renamed/merged and 221 IBBI rows without identifiers missing; voluntary/merger delistings X under-covered). A survivors-only sample from the same frame says P(<=0.5x) 7% instead of 11%.

body: Promise-credibility forward test, Nov-2026 cohort (NOT a recommendation; not buy/sell). The Anup Engineering (ANUP). Probability 0.45 (naive sector base rate 0.35) that: The Anup Engineering (ANUP) pending order book at 1-Apr-2027 >= Rs 760 cr (95% of Rs 800 cr). Probabilities set only by the pre-registered rule (research_notes/Promise tracker pilot/forward_test_2026-11/prereg.md s4): p0 = 0.348 (sector peers (Capital Goods), group 'revenue', n=69); SAC +0.437 x w 0.231 (N=6) -> P_cred = 0.45. Evidence: call of 2026-11-06: "come 1st of April 2027, we should open the year with an order book position of INR800 crores to INR900 crores" (Q2FY27). Resolution: YES if the Q4FY27 call/presentation states the pending order book at 31-Mar/1-Apr-2027 (or "as on date" in the Q4 call if no year-end figure) >= Rs 760 cr. Source: company Q3/Q4 FY27 filings, presentations and call transcripts (NSE). Resolve by 2027-06-30; score Brier of P_cred vs P_base (prereg s5).
